description: Single-file canvas image editor: load via file input/drag-drop, adjustments (brightness/contrast/saturation/gamma), filters (grayscale/invert/sepia/blur), crop with selection rectangle, rotate/flip, histogram, before/after compare, undo history, PNG/JPEG export.

criteria: image_editor_model_01.html is one self-contained image editor (no libraries): images loaded from a file input or drag-and-drop and drawn to a canvas at real resolution, adjustment sliders for brightness, contrast, saturation and gamma implemented with real per-pixel or CSS-filter math, one-click filters (grayscale, invert, sepia, blur) that compose with adjustments, a crop tool with a draggable selection rectangle applied for real, rotate 90 and horizontal/vertical flip, a luminance or RGB histogram drawn on a canvas, an undo history of at least 10 operations, a before/after toggle, and export to PNG and JPEG. Pixel operations must be genuine ImageData math, no faked previews.
